claims: The headliners for the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival are Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G.
The 25th edition of the festival takes place at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California.
The 25th edition of the festival takes place during the weekends of April 10–12 and April 17–19, 2026.
Karol G is the first Latina to headline Sunday.
